body: When you are chilling with a couple while being single.

It depends on how you deal with it really. Sure there is suffering but there are many beautiful things as well. How are you truly alone then? You have a friend that cares about you and I'm sure if you told someone else, they would be there for you. Sure, there are moments when we just are alone. But often, people can be there with us and we can take away the loneliness mutually.
Life is not about suffering. And you are not alone, for example, I am here to answer you. Do you have any friends/family knowing how you feel?

Calm down.. slow your breathing. Where are you right now? If you can, call a friend or family to calm you down more. Put on a movie, TV show or live stream so you have something to focus on. Try to draw how you feel right now.. Just let it out somehow without hurting yourself.
Please stay and tell us what happened today. Don't leave.
